name: @kiwa-test/hono
description: HonoJS Cloudflare Workers + hc RPC type-safe client + middleware chain test adapter for kiwa — invoke Hono app.request / route / middleware without a real Workers runtime, capture middleware execution order + context state + hc RPC request / response typing, and mock Workers env (KV / D1 / R2 / ExecutionContext) for assertion-based testing (part of the kiwa test framework family)

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/app.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/rpc.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/workers.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/src/index.js'
